services.name: Visiting Yachts
services.desc: Located at the head of St. Margaret’s Bay, Shining Waters Marina is the perfect place to stop along your journey while being a destination unto itself with Customs Clearance Services available with prior notification. We offer slips and moorings for visiting boats, pre booking required through our marina office. Please complete the ‘Visiting Yacht’ form below and e-mail it to jill@shiningwaters.ca to request short term moorage & dockage. Longer term clients come for the summer and will often choose to haul and store for the winter looking to benefit from maintenance/ storage/ services with tax benefits for international clients. Featuring a robust array of services and local amenities

blurb: Shining Waters Marina offers haul and launch services for power and sailboats up to 50T and 16' wide, dockside fuel, water, pump out, and various boat maintenance services including paint, polish, waxing, detailing, ceramic coating, and fiberglass repairs. They also provide battery storage and charging, solar and electrical services, launch ramp, moorings, and stand-up paddle board rentals and sales.
